title: A helpdesk on your Taskiem email address
summary: Every email to your helpdesk address becomes a numbered ticket for the right department; customers' replies join their ticket.
description: Give customers your helpdesk workflow's Taskiem email address (or forward your support mailbox to it). Each new email becomes a ticket with a number (T-1042), saved in your tickets table, and the customer is answered at once in the same conversation with their number. When the customer replies, the reply joins their ticket, the ticket is open again and the department is told. A reply to a ticket resolved more than a few days ago (you choose how many) opens a new ticket that says which one it follows. You write your departments once; Taskiem's AI (or your words, or the customer's choice) sends each ticket to the right one, and its members are told on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email. They answer with the Answer customers' tickets form, and the Follow up tickets workflow reminds them and closes old tickets.

variables.name: ticket_reply_form
variables.why: The link of your ticket reply form (the Answer customers' tickets workflow), put in each message to a department so they can answer at once.

params.name: departments
params.title: Departments
params.description: One department per line: its name, the role whose members answer its tickets, what it looks after, and words that send a ticket there, separated by a | sign. For example: Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment
params.example:
Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment, charged
Delivery | dispatch | Orders on their way, late or damaged deliveries | delivery, late, rider, damaged
General | support | Anything else |

params.name: default_department
params.title: Department when none fits
params.description: One of your departments, by its name: it gets the tickets that fit no other.

params.name: routing
params.title: How a ticket finds its department
params.description: ai: Taskiem's AI reads the message and picks the department, how urgent it is and a one-line summary. rules (the default): the first department with one of its words in the message. chosen: the department the customer picked.

params.name: acknowledgement
params.title: What the customer is told first
params.description: The first answer a customer gets when they write; their ticket's reference is added after it.
params.default: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.
params.example: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.

params.name: reopen_days
params.title: Days a resolved ticket can be reopened
params.description: A customer who writes back within these days after their ticket was resolved reopens it; later, they get a new ticket that says which one it follows.

definition.name: Helpdesk email
definition.description: Opens a ticket for each new email to the helpdesk address, and adds customers' replies to their tickets.

steps.name: Find the ticket the email answers
Is it a new ticket or a reply
Add the reply to its ticket, or open a ticket
Add the customer's reply to the ticket
Tell the department the customer answered

input.title: ='The customer answered on ' + steps.find.output.rows[0].reference

(trigger.body.latest != '' ? trigger.body.latest : (trigger.body.text != '' ? trigger.body.text : '(no text)')).substring(0, 500) : (trigger.body.latest != '' ? trigger.body.latest : (trigger.body.text != '' ? trigger.body.text : '(no text)')))
